name: Classic French Meringue
target_attribute: Ultra-light airy foam with overrun > 600%, glossy stiff peaks, and high resistance to liquid drainage before baking.
instructions_summary: Whip egg whites at room temperature with cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Gradually incorporate superfine sugar one tablespoon at a time until stiff glossy peaks appear.

name: Stabilized Chantilly Whipped Cream
target_attribute: Rich, creamy, pipeable emulsion foam with overrun ~100% and high yield stress governed by 3D fat crystal network.
instructions_summary: Chill bowl and beaters to 4°C. Whip heavy cream with sugar at medium-high speed until fat crystal network bridges and stiff peaks form. Do not over-whip into butter.

name: Whole Milk Steamed Foam (Unstabilized)
target_attribute: Temporary microfoam with overrun ~80-100%, prone to rapid liquid drainage due to milk fat destabilization.
instructions_summary: Aerate whole milk with steam wand to 60-65°C to denature whey proteins, sweeten with sugar, and serve immediately before drainage collapse occurs.

name: Low-Fat Hydrocolloid-Stabilized Dessert Foam
target_attribute: Light foam substituting 80g of milk and hydrocolloid for heavy cream, retaining structural stability with <2% total lipid content.
instructions_summary: Hydrate gelatin in milk and gently warm to melt. Whip egg whites to soft peaks with sugar, then fold in cooled gelatin-milk mixture to set elastic triple-helix matrix.

name: Vegan Aquafaba Meringue
target_attribute: Plant-based egg-free meringue utilizing legume polysaccharides and albumins with xanthan gum stabilization.
instructions_summary: Whip reduced aquafaba with cream of tartar and xanthan gum until high volume stiff foam forms, slowly streaming in granulated sugar.
